run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T07:19:01Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is firing because frontend cannot complete calls to checkout. frontend's own ERROR-status spans appear only on its checkout path (POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, tcp.connect). Its cumulative ERROR span counter was flat at 1906 through 07:17:01 and climbed to 3582 by 07:29:01, and its client PlaceOrder spans flipped from ~0.85/s successful to ~0.8-1.0/s ERROR while checkout's server-side PlaceOrder and HTTP POST span rates fell from ~0.7-0.9/s and ~2.2-2.8/s to 0 between 07:19:01 and 07:23:01. The cause traces to a single pod: checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q is Running but NotReady with restartCount 11 in CrashLoopBackOff (last termination exitCode 2, reason Error, 5s runtime), Service checkout has only notReadyAddresses, and the pod's live spec now runs image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest for both the checkout container and the wait-for-kafka init container, while the Deployment checkout and ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb templates still declare ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout and busybox:latest and the pod's own annotations preserve those original image names. A kubelet event 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' starts at 07:17:54, immediately before frontend errors begin. No other workload in otel-demo is unhealthy.

claims.text: frontend emitted ERROR-status spans on only its checkout path: span_name POST (418.1 increase/1h), POST /api/checkout (418.1), executing api route (pages) /api/checkout (418.1), grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (418.1) and tcp.connect (28.4). Its other operations (GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/cart and /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart) show 0 ERROR increase.

The frontend traces_span_metrics_calls_total ERROR counter was constant at 1906 from 06:55:01 through 07:17:01, then rose to 1973 (07:19:01), 2257, 2417, 2938, 3226 and 3582 (07:29:01); it then stayed at 3582 for the remaining points. The STATUS_CODE_UNSET counter also froze at 133131 from 07:29:01.

frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder switched from success to failure: STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate ~0.83-0.93/s until 07:19:01 and 0 from 07:23:01, while STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate was 0 until 07:17:01 and then 0.17 (07:19:01), 0.56, 0.78, 0.83, 0.94, 1.0, 0.89, 0.80, 0.83 and 0.98/s up to 07:29:01.

checkout stopped serving: service_name="checkout" span_name="oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" rate was ~0.73-0.92/s through 07:19:01 (0.644), 0.278 at 07:21:01 and 0 from 07:23:01 onward; service_name="checkout" span_name="HTTP POST" rate was ~2.06-2.77/s through 07:19:01 (1.93) and 0 from 07:21:01 onward.

checkout does not appear at all in the per-service STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increase for the window, i.e. no checkout span series carried an error status; the services that do appear with errors are ad (~2.0-3.1/h), fraud-detection (~2.0-3.0/h), recommendation (~2.0-3.0/h), frontend (68.4 rising to 1701/h) and frontend-proxy (45.9 rising to 857/h).

Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q in namespace otel-demo is phase Running but READY false with restartCount 11, while every other pod in the namespace is Running and READY true with restartCount 0 (e.g. frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-c8ks2, cart-755465879b-7khmf).

The checkout container of checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q is in state waiting with reason CrashLoopBackOff and message 'back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=checkout pod=checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q_otel-demo(6b803e7a-86b0-47d4-b95d-e4c9bee17da2)'; its lastState is terminated with exitCode 2, reason Error, startedAt 07:24:49 and finishedAt 07:24:54. The pod's Ready and ContainersReady conditions have been False (reason ContainersNotReady, 'containers with unready status: [checkout]') since 07:24:54. Pod owner is ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb.

The live spec of pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q sets the container named checkout to image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest (name checkout) and the init container wait-for-kafka to gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest, with no readiness, liveness or startup probes; the pod's annotations record 'checkout-normal':'ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout' and 'wait-for-kafka-init':'busybox:latest'.

Only the checkout pod runs the pause image; the other 20 pods in otel-demo run their normal images, e.g. frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg runs ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-frontend and cart-755465879b-7khmf runs ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-cart.

The Deployment checkout template is unchanged and still declares image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout with init image busybox:latest and status.replicas 1, but status.availableReplicas and status.readyReplicas are absent (no available replica); every other otel-demo deployment shows AVAILABLE 1 and READY 1.

ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (owner deployment checkout) still has template image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout and readyReplicas absent — the same ReplicaSet and the same pod name as before the incident, so no rollout replaced the pod.

Kubelet events on pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q: reason Killing 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' count 7 from 07:17:54 to 07:20:54; reason Pulled 'Container image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest" already present on machine' count 6 from 07:17:54 to 07:24:21; reason BackOff 'Back-off restarting failed container checkout ...' count 26 (Warning) from 07:19:54 to 07:25:42.

The Service endpoints object checkout has no ready addresses: its only subset contains a notReadyAddresses entry 100.96.4.26 (nodeName i-01375feffdca65277, targetRef Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q) on port tcp-service 8080.

The checkout container's readable log stream shows a healthy order flow ('[PlaceOrder]', 'payment went through', 'order placed', 'order confirmation email sent to ...', 'Successful to write message') and its newest retained line is at 2026-11-15T07:04:03.651053Z; 2239 lines were read from that stream and the newest 200 were shown.

frontend-proxy has its own ERROR-status spans rising in the same window: span_name ingress from 29.6 (07:19:01) to 437.3 (07:29:01) increase/1h and span_name 'router frontend egress' from 16.3 to 420.1 increase/1h.

Jaeger's newest trace for service frontend inside the authorized window starts at 2026-11-15T07:11:56.903539Z (source_end_at 07:11:57.307351); the spans shown for that trace carry http.status_code 200/308 and rpc.grpc.status_code "0" with no error rows, so no failing span detail exists for the incident period.

The Jaeger service list contains the name 'checkout' among 18 services, and frontend's client operations include grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, so the checkout dependency is a real instrumented service and the name was not mistyped.

checkout's own span_name label values are HTTP POST, orders publish, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart.

Primary cause: pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q had its container definition changed in place to the pause image at ~07:17:54 (Deployment and ReplicaSet templates unchanged, pod annotations preserving the original image names), which removed the checkout application process. checkout then had no ready endpoint, so frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder calls failed and frontend's own POST /api/checkout spans errored, raising frontend's request error rate and firing RequestErrorRate.

frontend's tcp.connect ERROR spans (28.4 increase/1h) are failed connection attempts to checkout:8080, consistent with the Service having only notReadyAddresses; the peer identity cannot be confirmed because no frontend span with tags is retrievable after 07:11:57.

frontend-proxy's rising ERROR spans on ingress and 'router frontend egress' are the proxied frontend /api/checkout failures (frontend returning 5xx through the proxy). The direction is plausible from naming and timing but the exact request path is unverified because the corresponding traces are not in Jaeger for this period.

The repeated ~5-second terminations with exitCode 2 are the pause image's process failing to stay up in the application container slot; the exact reason is not visible because no log lines exist for the post-07:04:03 container instances and the previous instance's logs returned 'previous terminated container ... not found'.

checkout itself reported no error status before it stopped serving: it has no STATUS_CODE_ERROR span series in the window and its readable logs show successful orders through 07:04:03, so the checkout-side failure evidence is loss of availability (unready pod, no ready endpoints, zero serving rate), not application-level error reporting.

Rejected: that checkout was OOMKilled or Evicted. The container's last termination reason is Error with exitCode 2 (not OOMKilled), and the only warning event on the pod is the BackOff restart event — no Evicted event and no OOMKilled reason was returned.

Rejected: that the checkout pod was rolled out or rescheduled by its controller and that the new pod is merely starting. The pod name and ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb are unchanged, its restart count is 11 (in-place container restarts, not a new pod), and events show Killing/Created/Started for the same container in the same pod with no SuccessfulCreate or SuccessfulDelete.

Rejected: that the falling error ratio after 07:29:01 (5m ERROR rate 2.42 → 1.92 → 1.49 → 0.95/s) means frontend recovered. The raw frontend ERROR counter is frozen at 3582 and the UNSET counter at 133131 from 07:29:01 across the remaining points, and every service's span counters plateau at the same time, so the decline reflects missing samples, not recovery.

Rejected: that the small error-span counts on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation are part of this incident. They hold roughly steady at 2.0-3.1 per hour from the first point of the window, including before frontend errors began, and their overall span volumes do not change with the incident.

Rejected: that the frontend pod itself is damaged. frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg is Running, READY true with restartCount 0, it runs its normal image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-frontend, and deployment frontend reports AVAILABLE 1 / READY 1; frontend's failure is confined to its checkout-dependent operations.

Restore checkout by deleting pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q so ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (which still declares ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) recreates it, then confirm the pod becomes Ready, Service checkout gains a ready address, and frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder ERROR rate returns to 0.

Identify what rewrote the checkout pod spec at ~07:17:54 (in-place image replacement with gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest plus the checkout-normal and wait-for-kafka-init annotations that hold the original image names) using cluster audit logs or the fault-injection controller's records, and block that source; separately investigate why span metrics stop advancing after ~07:29:01 and Jaeger traces after 07:11:57, since both blind the observability data behind this alert.

gaps: The Prometheus alerting rule RequestErrorRate is not present in this Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate (no_data) and with type=alert (no_data) both returned nothing, so the alert's exact expression, evaluation window and threshold (annotation 'current: 3.4999999999999996') could not be verified.

Jaeger has no traces after 2026-11-15T07:11:57, so the failing frontend spans' tags, gRPC status codes, error messages and the peer of the tcp.connect spans are unknown for the incident period; searches for frontend traces in 07:20:00-07:30:00 and for error=true returned nothing.
traces_span_metrics_calls_total for every service stops incrementing at ~07:29:01 (frontend ERROR frozen at 3582, UNSET at 133131), so service behaviour between 07:29:01 and 07:37:16 is unmeasured.
fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg returned no lines for 07:14:00-07:37:16, so frontend's client-side error text could not be read.

checkout container logs after 07:04:03 are unavailable and the previous container instance's logs returned 'previous terminated container ... not found', so the reason the pause-image container exits with code 2 cannot be read from logs.

get_series for kube_pod_container_info of checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q returned no series, and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/ready returned no data for deployment checkout, so image digests and a cluster-metric view of readiness were not available.
The otel-collector pod log read returned no lines, so a collector-side drop or export failure cannot be confirmed or excluded as the cause of the trace/span-metric stall.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what mutated the checkout pod spec at ~07:17:54 could not be confirmed.
The checkout container ran from 06:42:45 until it was killed at 07:17:54 but its last retained log line is 07:04:03; its state in that ~13-minute gap is unknown.

A checkout-scoped search of STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans returned no_data and a checkout trace search in the incident window returned no_data, so those absences are unknown rather than proof of zero checkout errors.
next_steps: Review cluster audit logs and the fault-injection/chaos controller records for an in-place pod spec patch on checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q at ~07:17:54 (image checkout -> gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest).
After restoring the pod, confirm Service checkout has a ready address and watch frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR return to 0 before clearing the alert.
Check otel-collector and jaeger-all-in-one for the trace pipeline stall after 07:11:57 and the span-metric stall after ~07:29:01, and restore the data so the alert's signal is trustworthy.
If exact failing-span detail is needed, read the frontend container's stderr from its node directly, since pod logs were not retrievable in this Run.
